name: tiny_n_gemm
description: Thin-N GEMM for decode projections: out = cast(x.float() @ w.float().T, out_dtype), where x is [M,K], w is [N,K], and out is [M,N]. m == 1 uses a GEMV path; larger M uses a tiled dot (optionally split-K based on the hardware SM count), both accumulated in float32. out_dtype is a torch.dtype and may be bfloat16 or float32. Returns a newly allocated tensor and does not mutate x or w. Suites exercise bfloat16 x/w with bfloat16 and float32 output dtypes.
